summary: BioNTech SE filed a 6-K with the SEC on May 7, 2026, announcing a new share repurchase program authorizing up to $1.0 billion in ADS repurchases through May 6, 2027. Repurchases will be made in open-market transactions under Rule 10b-18 and may utilize Rule 10b5-1 plans. The company funded the program from existing cash resources. Repurchased ADSs will satisfy ordinary-course obligations, including employee equity awards. The program aims to enhance capital efficiency and signals management's confidence in the company's long-term growth. The board authorized the program without external advisors. This is a routine capital return event with no special-situation catalyst beyond ongoing share buybacks.
